English: FanFolder

FanFolder is a lightweight Windows taskbar utility that gives you one-click access to the files you are working with. Click the FanFolder icon on the taskbar and your recent files appear in an animated fan menu. For a normal folder, FanFolder prioritizes the most recently modified items; the default Recent Documents source uses Windows recent-document history.

Choose any local folder, including folders synchronized with OneDrive, Dropbox, or Google Drive. Open an item with one click, drag it to another application, or right-click it to use the standard Windows Shell context menu.

Choose from five animation styles: Fan, Glide, Spring, Fade, or None. Configure the folder, sort order, number of items, filename filter, folder visibility, and file-extension display.

FanFolder uses native Win32/C++ technology, Windows Shell integration, and per-user settings. It has no runtime dependencies, no account requirement, and no network connection is required for normal operation. Installation is per-user and does not require administrator rights.

FanFolder is free for personal and commercial use. It supports Windows 10 version 1809 or later and Windows 11 on x64 and ARM64.
